# openstatus_status_page_component (Resource)

Manages a status page component (monitor or static).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openstatus_status_page_component" "api_monitor" {
  page_id    = openstatus_status_page.main.id
  type       = "monitor"
  monitor_id = openstatus_http_monitor.api.id
  name       = "API"
  order      = 1
}

resource "openstatus_status_page_component" "info" {
  page_id = openstatus_status_page.main.id
  type    = "static"
  name    = "Third-party Services"
  order   = 2
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `page_id` (String)
- `type` (String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `group_id` (String)
- `group_order` (Number) Display order of the component within its group.
- `monitor_id` (String) Required when type is `monitor`.
- `name` (String)
- `order` (Number) Display order of the component's group on the status page.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `updated_at` (String)
